content_sections.text: Young Professional (Media & Public Relations): Master Degree in Journalism from a recognized university/Institute. content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIA Young Professional (Media & Public Relations) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Young Professional (Media & Public Relations) at the All India Institute of Ayurveda (AIIA).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Young Professional (Media & Public Relations) position under this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 06 October 2026. Candidates must report on this date to the designated venue.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Master Degree in Journalism from a recognized university or institute to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any experience required?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates are required to have 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in the field of Public Relations, preferably in a government or autonomous body.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Young Professional (Media & Public Relations) post is 40 years as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs 50,000 for the contractual period.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted in the Committee Room of the Academic Block of the All India Institute of Ayurveda (AIIA), New Delhi.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, this recruitment is for a contractual position at the All India Institute of Ayurveda, as specified in the official job notification.

faq.question: Q10. Do I need to apply online before the interview?
faq.answer: No, this is a direct walk-in interview recruitment. Candidates are required to appear directly at the venue with their documents on the specified date.
